title: NotRexed/Hookshot
why_read: A native recompilation of Ocarina of Time targeting Nintendo Switch 2 is technically interesting as a reverse-engineering and static recompilation project, though the legal status is murky.
analysis: Static recompilation converts a game's original machine code into compilable C or C++ source, allowing the game to run natively on a new platform without emulation overhead. Projects like this require disassembling the original ROM, reconstructing control flow, and mapping hardware-specific behavior to new APIs. The Switch 2 target adds complexity because it involves a newer Arm-based SoC with different graphics and audio subsystems. The 5000+ stars suggest strong community interest, but redistribution of the original game's assets would be legally problematic.
